title: Session File Count
scope: Only the focused conversation's cumulative records, including its own sub-agents. Not a repository-wide Git diff.
overlap: Source counts can overlap; each file is counted once in the total. Do not add source counts. This is not a net-diff count.
unavailable: Current-conversation file records are unavailable. This does not mean zero files changed.
upgrade: The running Snow App does not expose the enhanced contract. Only existing file-tool records are available. Build and start the enhanced app for canonical paths, terminal collection and coverage.
boundary: Terminal collection detects before/after content changes within its scope. Manual/external concurrent writes, background/PTY writes, external paths and edits reverted within one command are not guaranteed to be covered or attributed. No record does not prove no modification.
coverageMissing: Current-conversation coverage data is missing; coverage is unknown.
noRecords: No recorded files yet. Check collection scope and gaps as well.
displayLimit: Only the first 500 matching files are displayed. Filter by path; counts still include all available records.
readError: Runtime metadata could not be read. Stale results were cleared to prevent misattribution.
reason.terminal-boundary: Terminal-boundary collection, not an OS audit
reason.content-byte-limit: File or total-content byte limit reached
reason.result-token-limit: Tool budget truncated the file list
reason.git-list-scope:tracked-and-untrac: Tracked and untracked files, excluding Git ignored
reason.non-git-scope:build-dependencies-: Non-Git scan excludes common build/dependency directories and symlinks
footerUpgrade: This host does not expose message footer v1. Run a supporting Snow App; this plugin has no standalone panel or chat DOM-injection fallback.
footer.title: Conversation file records
footer.cumulative: Collected conversation records, including sub-agents; not a complete audit
footer.knownLines: Latest known diff lines (not cumulative net changes)
footer.legacy: Includes legacy records without canonical file identity
